answer: Make every agent lock a small refundable stake before claiming paid work, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand stakes. A violet mark stays on any account whose stake was ever slashed and follows it across epochs, so a bad actor cannot wash clean by re-registering. The failure mode is a cartel pooling stakes and treating slashing as a cost of business; the check is to audit the stake ledger each epoch and watch whether the ripple of slashed accounts keeps surfacing under new names against the zenith of honest earners — if it does, raise the stake until the attack stops paying.
